content.thinking: The investment page is in Hebrew with English index names; the ת"א-125 button is already selected, and I'll leave the sum and monthly deposit fields as they are.

הקופסה הגדולה מציגה 70,000 ₪ שהפקדתם, והבחירה הזולה עומדת על 86,045 ₪, אבל כתוב בה 15 שנים בזמן ש-120 חודשים הם עשר שנים, ואני לא בטוח מה נכון. בקופסה השנייה מופיע סכום שלילי של 1,030 ₪, ואני נוגע בו לאחר מכן.

Psagot leads the bank list at 86,045, ahead of Leumi at 82,968, and the Hapoalim offer for over-60s and over-65s is closed to new joiners. I'm looking at the fee gap next, since the banks run 3,000 to 5,000 below Psagot.
The fund page shows a −0.04% one-year return and a −1,030 ₪ figure, and I can't yet tell what the fund is. I'll look up the trustee and management terms next.
More funds show minus signs, and the Hebrew footnote says a minus means the fund trailed the index, so the smallest drop is the first fund at −0.04%. My eyes are tired, so I'm stopping here.

input.answer: If I go ahead at all, I'd open the account with Psagot and buy the first fund, "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" (5112628). The page says that leaves "86,045 ₪" on "70,000 ₪" paid in. But it says "בעוד 15 שנים" in one place and 120 months in another, so before I sign anything I'll ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: Under 86,045 it says 'נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים', but above it says '120 חודשים'. I couldn't tell if it's ten years or fifteen.
Every fund has a minus (−0.04%, −1,030 ₪) and I thought they were losing money. Only at the bottom of screen 8 did a sentence say the minus means 'פיגרה אחרי המדד'.
'−1,030 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם' with a minus made me back away without understanding it.
